tier.name: Foundation Phase
tier.summary: Your organization is at the start of its digital journey. The priority now is a solid digital foundation that prepares the way for AI.
tier.diagnosis: The organization depends heavily on manual and paper processes, and data is scattered in isolated spreadsheets.
tier.direction: Focus on digitizing core processes and leaving paper and scattered Excel files before moving to advanced AI.

data.strengthsMessage: No standout strengths appeared in the measured areas. That is normal at the start of a digital journey. The recommendations and 90-day plan below are designed to build those foundations step by step.

gaps.text: Weak field documentation and reliance on informal communication (WhatsApp).
A high share of manual entry and moving data between screens, which consumes time.
Manual sorting and assignment of seasonal labor, which creates operating bottlenecks.
No live geographic tracking (GPS) for how teams are spread in the field.
Data scattered in personal Excel files, which blocks building AI models.

recommendations.title: Quality automation and service-level (SLA) compliance.
recommendations.description: Automatic routing of reports, escalation before a service standard is broken, and a live record.
recommendations.expectedROI: Cut field-report response time by 50% and keep full compliance.

recommendations.title: Establish a cloud data warehouse and connect APIs.
recommendations.description: Unify scattered sources into one secure database that is ready for AI.
recommendations.expectedROI: Save 80% of the weekly effort spent preparing manual reports.

recommendations.title: Live management and tracking of field operations and deployment.
recommendations.description: Heat maps and live tracking of geographic coverage and field teams through GPS.
recommendations.expectedROI: Remove field blind spots and raise team coverage efficiency by 35%.

recommendations.title: Smart hiring, sorting, and matching for seasonal staff.
recommendations.description: Automatic matching of labor skills to field needs, and automatic geographic placement.
recommendations.expectedROI: Cut seasonal sorting and placement from weeks to a few hours.

roadmap.title: Definition and path design
roadmap.action: Document field procedures, define SLA indicators, and prepare the digital structure

roadmap.title: Prepare Hajj Ma'yar and integrate data
roadmap.action: Prepare Hajj Ma'yar, connect APIs to current systems, and load the central data

roadmap.title: Pilot Hajj Ma'yar
roadmap.action: Launch Hajj Ma'yar on a pilot scope (one camp or one sector) and train the teams

roadmap.title: Full launch
roadmap.action: Run every facility, and turn on the command room and live monitoring screens
